title: Answer: no account of free will, though macro causes answer the exclusion argument

statements.text: Causal emergence takes no position on free will and gives no definition of agency. What it offers nearby is a reply to the causal exclusion argument, which is often used against mental causation: the macro level supervenes on the micro but can supersede it causally. From a system's own perspective, causal emergence means its causal self-definition sits at the optimal macro level, where its causal interactions come into focus.
statements.scope: Quantifying causal emergence shows that macro can beat micro (2013)
